[EN] Damned argons! Every time I fix my hair, they come lumbering around the corner.

Fortunately, with this teleport platform, we don't have to dodge quite as many of them.
[ES] ¡Malditos argons! Cada vez que me arreglo el cabello, aparecen caminando torpemente a la vuelta de la esquina.

Afortunadamente, con esta plataforma de teletransporte, no tenemos que esquivar a tantos.
